name: 学習結果から次の本へ進む
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese learning-results screen on a 390 × 740 px portrait canvas. Use the native preview for exact Japanese copy, type, layout and component geometry. Use the Headway screenshot as source context for content and locked next-step state. Use reference 3 as the exact recommended-book cover artwork and place it unchanged. Return the component canvas only, without phone frame, status bar or app chrome.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep all interface surfaces pure white #FFFFFF: page, recommendation card, action areas and bottom next-step control. Remove the pale mint fill from “第2段階へ進む”; render that unavailable action on white with a thin neutral #E4E4E4 outline and readable neutral-gray text. The source screen has a cream page background and pale-gray disabled action; remove these tints. Use thin neutral separators, near-black #1D1D1D primary text, #6E6E6E supporting text, and solid forest green #047857 for result checks, the recommendation-card outline and the two solid Listen/Read actions. No mint, cream, blush, gray or other pale tinted surfaces, gradients, glows, shadows or decorative texture. Preserve original colors only inside the supplied book-cover image.

Match the native layout exactly:
- Heading at x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28: “今回の結果”.
- Five green checkmarks at x=20 and y=68, 102, 136, 170 and 204, each 14×12, with corresponding text at x=48 and y=62, 96, 130, 164 and 198, 326×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24:
  “論理的に考える”
  “数を扱うことが得意”
  “パターンや因果に気づく”
  “問題を解く力がある”
  “戦略を立てられる”
- White recommendation card at x=16/y=272, 358×272, 4 px corners, thin forest-green outline. Heading x=32/y=286, 326×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28: “次の一歩のために学ぶ”. Supporting line x=32/y=324, 326×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16: “この結果に合わせた学びのヒント”.
- Exact supplied book cover at x=32/y=356, 66×101, unchanged. To its right: title x=116/y=358, 242×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, “お金との付き合い方を学ぶ”; author x=116/y=392, 242×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, neutral gray, “ラミット・セティ”; metadata x=116/y=426, 242×16, same style, “15分　・　8つの学び”.
- Solid forest-green “聞く” button at x=32/y=472, 152×52, radius 10, white centered Meiryo Regular 14/24. Solid forest-green “読む” button at x=202/y=472, 152×52, same style.
- Centered supporting text at x=16/y=594, 358×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, “この要約を終えると、結果をさらに深く見られます。”
- Bottom next-step control at x=16/y=642, 358×58, white with fine neutral outline and 8 px corners. Center “第2段階へ進む” at x=24/y=660, 342×24, Meiryo Bold 14/24 in neutral gray to preserve its unavailable/locked state without a tinted fill.

Preserve every listed Japanese string and the exact recommended-book cover. Keep spacing compact and readable. Do not add a lock icon, badges, or any other content absent from the native component. The large surrounding page stays white.
reviewNotes: Pure-white interface surfaces and no pale tint fills verified. The title, result list, recommendation card and actions sit substantially below native vertical anchors; one correction planned.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
